beats.actTag: YEAR 2035 • WHEN MARGINAL COST TOUCHES ZERO
beats.narration:
By twenty thirty-five, a quiet mathematical revolution arrived on municipal balance sheets around the world.
Once solar roofs, hundred-hour batteries, automated logistics, and precision harvests paid off their initial capital, the marginal cost of generating an extra kilowatt-hour of clean electricity or growing staple family nutrition dropped close to zero!

beats.actTag: ACT I • ABHAYA-DANA: THE SUPREME GIFT OF FEARLESSNESS

beats.narration:
In the Vedic tradition, the highest of all gifts is Abhaya-Dana—the gift of fearlessness.
Think about what millennia of survival terror—'Will the power be shut off? Will my children go hungry if my job changes?'—did to the human nervous system! Chronic cortisol locked billions of gifted minds inside fight-or-flight mode.

beats.actTag: ACT II • PREVENTATIVE BIO-VITALITY & ACTIVE ELDERS

beats.narration:
At the exact same moment, healthcare flipped its economic model upside down—returning to Ayurveda's foundational axiom: Swasthasya Swasthya Rakshanam, protecting the health of the healthy before illness ever takes root!
Non-invasive optical wearables, microbiome profiling, and AI-designed precision biologics began catching metabolic, cardiovascular, and cellular inflammation years before symptoms appeared—allowing elders in their seventies to live with vibrant physical energy.
